outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the differentiation protocol, not a plot, and contains no statistical comparisons.
Panel B shows western blot images, not a quantitative plot, and no significance symbols are present.

Panel C consists of line plots of gene expression over time with error bars (mean ± SEM) but no significance symbols (e.g., asterisks) are present on the plots or mentioned in the caption, so no symbol definition is required.
Panel D shows live imaging micrographs, not a plot, with no significance indicators.
Panel E shows flow cytometry dot plots with gate percentages; no statistical significance symbols are present.
Panel F is a line plot of positive cell proportions with error bars; no significance symbols are shown on the plot or referenced in the caption.
Panel G is a line plot of positive cell proportions with error bars; no significance symbols are shown on the plot or referenced in the caption.
Panel H shows immunostaining micrographs, not a plot, with no significance indicators.
Panel I shows Tukey boxplots of RNA-seq quantifications across 8 sorted populations; no significance symbols (e.g., asterisks, brackets) are visible on the plots or mentioned in the caption.
Panel J shows hierarchical clustering heatmaps of gene expression (Z-score log2FC); no statistical significance symbols are present.
